intro.text: Chris Cilibrasi has run Chris's Complete Landscaping since 2011. It's an owner-operated company that keeps Long Island lawns and landscape beds neat through every season: weekly lawn service, spring and fall cleanups, fresh mulch and plantings, bush trimming, aeration, topsoil and power washing, plus snow removal in winter.
intro.quote: We may be a small company but we treat every customer like family.

services.d: Routine mowing and lawn care to keep the property neat all season.
Leaves, branches and seasonal debris cleared out.
Fresh mulch and new plantings for instant curb appeal.
Bush trimming, lawn aeration and topsoil.
Power washing outside, plus snow removal in winter.

reviews.text: A quick review helps your neighbors find a landscaper they can count on.
